Missing dependencies, initialization, account/window changes, draft and unknown submission map to fixed notices; external exception text discarded. Actual imported WxResponse type may use documented bool semantics, while arbitrary truthy objects/dicts never confirm submission. Window change stops accepting callbacks and clears pending targets. Actual microphones, real provider quality, clipboard compatibility and automatic mobile/cloud synchronization remain unvalidated or missing.
